messages:
Mira: kicking off migration for orders.reorder_events — adding NOT NULL on customer_id. Backfill will run in 50k-row batches with a rate limiter.

deploybot: scheduled rollout in maintenance window 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC. change_id: ch-6543. pinned service version: inference-api v2.14.3

Sam: canary on shard-3 only, 5% of traffic. holdpoint at batch 10 (approx 30m).

Mira: ops playbook: <https://wiki/redwood/runtime/migrations|migration-runbook> — snapshot, holdpoints, abort criteria all documented.

Eden: preflight checks: schema diff clean, all replicas caught up, queued rows ~1.2M, table size ~42GB.

Mira: plan summary:
- Create DB snapshot
- Apply migration with lease: row_lock_timeout=30s
- Start backfill job (rate-limited, 50k batches)
- Canary on shard-3, holdpoint + metric check
- Staged rollout across shards on green

Sam: abort conditions (immediate stop): replication lag > 200ms, primary CPU > 85%, error rate spike > 0.5% for write path.

Eden: monitoring: grafana -> infra/db/backfill, alerts posted to #eng-oncall. I'll attach a dashboard link before the run.

deploybot: canary deploy started on shard-3 at 02:05 UTC — job_id: jb-6543-1.

Eden: canary batch 1/10 finished, no errors in logs, tail QPS stable.

Sam: quick verification query run: SELECT count(*) FROM orders.reorder_events WHERE customer_id IS NULL AND processed_shard = 3; -> 0 for processed ranges.

Mira: if we need to abort quickly, flip feature flag "reorder_events_strict_mode" -> false: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/flags/reorder_events_strict_mode -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' -d '{"value":false}'
```

opslead: rollback runbook (if required):
1) Cancel backfill job(s)
2) Apply rollback migration ch-6543-revert (schema revert)
3) Ensure read traffic pinned to safe version (inference-api v2.14.3)
4) Open incident, notify affected customers, start postmortem

oncall: I'll be on watch for the first 45 minutes and will page if alerts fire. paging policy adjusted for this window.

deploybot: canary completed at 02:18 UTC — canary_success: true. Promoting to shards 1..12 with staged rollout.

Mira: staged rollout strategy: double batch concurrency every 12 minutes, monitor replication lag, DB CPU, and error rate. Hold on any threshold breach.

Eden: note — backfills can bloat WAL; temporarily bump wal_keep_segments to 2048 for the window. Ops will revert post-rollout.

Sam: release notes tag: ch-6543, risk: medium, user impact: potential read latency increase for heavy tenants, no expected downtime.

Mira: final pre-full checks: confirm snapshots exist + run dry-run on canary tenant (tenant_id=5823).

Eden: dry-run succeeded. ready to proceed with staged rollout.

Mira: proceeding with staged rollout now. Will post any anomalies.

deploybot: rollout in progress: 4/12 shards updated (timestamp 02:41 UTC).

oncall: observed a small read latency spike (+12%) during shard-4 update, within expected threshold and stabilized in 3 mins.

Sam: adjusted rate limiter to 0.7 to smooth WAL generation and lower peak IO.

deploybot: rollout completed at 03:02 UTC. status: success. change_id: ch-6543. artifacts: logs/js-backfill-6543.tar.gz

Mira: closing thread — everything green. We'll open a short postmortem if we see any regression in next 24h. :white_check_mark:
